parole.significato: An Indonesian (Javanese) shrimp cracker, made from tapioca flour, salt, ground shrimps and various spices.
parole.testo: Borrowed from Dutch kroepoek, from Javanese ꦏꦿꦸꦥꦸꦏ꧀ (krupuk), from Old Javanese kurupuk (“a crunchy flake”).

parole.significato: A low-top shoe with a rubber sole and a canvas upper; a low-top canvas sneaker.
parole.testo: The etymology of the term is unclear and disputed. One possibility is that it comes from pomp (“ornamentation”). parole.significato: A traditional Malaysian and Indonesian salad of mixed raw fruits and vegetables served with a sauce.
parole.testo: From Dutch roedjak, from Javanese ꦫꦸꦗꦏ꧀ (rujak), from Old Javanese rujak.
